items.summary: Reject unsupported revenue, ROI, margin, forecast, and causal-lift claims. Amazon commission is aggregate and unattributed; AI cost is not a comparable margin input. Keep SearchWoot private and require owner approval before any outreach or launch change. Reject new high-priority queue work and production proposals until existing failures and measurement gates are resolved.

The proposed security evidence work is read-only but is high-priority queue work with no measurable outcome specified and unavailable internal telemetry cannot be repaired through this plan. Do not queue it here; retain the private gate and existing evidence-needed disposition.

Recommendation: approve no new production, growth, spending, or high-priority queue work this cycle. Fewer than three candidates are actionable: the remaining SEO opportunities are already active, failed, or awaiting repair, while telemetry supports no site-level revenue or ROI claims. Continue only existing bounded measurement, failure repair, and private launch-gate work. Owner decision question: should the existing Great American Lakes measurement gate remain unchanged until 2026-10-06 or 100 new impressions?
